We have invliadted your application as per request of case officer. The description of proposal is not clear, please provide full description of works? Also development looks retrospective as the works has already started, as stated in the application form, and hence a S192 application is not appropriate. The application form is incomplete, as you can see from the ground for application below as its fields are either incomplete or incomprehensible. 

 

Also, if the property is a house and benefit from Permitted development rights as such has not been specified in the application form. 

 

Also, the drawings are lacking, an example is the below ground floor plan where a wall will hang in the air, and I see the same thing in the proposed side elevation.
